titles.title: Blue Flower

description: An abstracted, pale blue and pink flower that resembles an orchid stretches across the canvas. In the upper righthand corner, a bright green stem is visible. The pastel colors of the flower are set against a plain white background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
